paper_title: Aviation Safety Enhancement via NLP Deep Learning for Flight Phase Classification
core_problem: The need for precise and systematic analysis of safety occurrences during different flight phases from safety reports to enhance aviation safety.
methodology_summary: Employing Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Deep Learning models, including LSTM, CNN, Bidirectional LSTM (BLSTM), and simple Recurrent Neural Networks (sRNN), to classify flight phases from safety reports.
datasets_eval: Safety reports from the Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB)
empirical_results: LSTM achieved the highest performance with an accuracy of 87%, precision of 88%, recall of 87%, and F1 score of 88%.
explicit_limitations: Manual analysis of safety occurrence reports is resource-intensive, limited by human capacity, subjectivity, and potential for oversight.
